CustomField.label: Event Attendee
CustomField.description: Who is invited. R5 replaced the Contact__c / Lead__c pair with this single lookup: every invitee is an Event_Attendee__c, so the junction has one head instead of two and no consumer has to ask which one is populated. Restrict, not SetNull — an attendee who has been invited to something cannot be deleted out from under an approval, and unlike the old Contact and Lead lookups this constraint only ever blocks deletion of a record this project owns.
